en: It's important to savor your food. Meals are meant to be pleasurable. Seeing them just as a means of sustenance isn't any fun.
Oh, I agree! Since I only eat one meal a day, I make sure it's a tasty one!
For all I know, I might die tomorrow. So I don't want to have any regrets about not eating something delicious!
I've never thought about it in such... extreme terms before.
But I wouldn't want to lose the enjoyment of eating by obsessing over stuff like nutrition and dieting.
Exactly. It'd be lame to be thin but not liked by anyone. You're missing out on life by not enjoying your food.
I'm with you there.
Check please.
Here you are! Thanks!
Sorry. Something came up all of a sudden.
Ah, I see. Well, swing by again sometime.
Thank you very much. Your bill comes to %s.
Thank you very much. Please come again.
Please follow me.
Welcome! What'll it be?
What do you recommend today?
Any recommendations today?
Hey boss, whaddya recommend today?
Hey chief, what's good today?
Do you have any recommendations?

For today, I highly recommend the <Color:8>Whole Sea Eel<Color:Default>.
It's really good!
<Color:8>Whole Sea Eel<Color:Default>, huh? Sounds good.
<Color:8>Whole Sea Eel<Color:Default>, huh? That sounds good.
<Color:8>Whole Sea Eel<Color:Default>, huh? Sounds tasty.
<Color:8>Whole Sea Eel<Color:Default>, huh? Sounds good to me!
<Color:8>Whole Sea Eel<Color:Default>? Oh, that sounds delicious!
What'll it be?
Sorry, but something came up. I have to get going.
My bad. I forgot somethin'. Sorry.
Sorry, sorry! There's this thing I gotta do. I have to get going.
I'm really sorry. Something just came up. You'll have to excuse me.

あ、えと、申し遅れました。私、
TVBros.という雑誌の編集をしております、
浅井と申します。
パスワードは「<Color:7>チャンス<Color:Default>」です。
Hello. I'll exchange your pachinko balls for prizes.
Thank you. We look forward to your next visit.
I see. We look forward to your next visit.
The cold's really takin' hold tonight. A man needs a good woman to keep him warm.
After a night out with the boys, food stall ramen just goes down so smooth. But man, all that salt and fat...
Something's wrong. Only ten minutes till our meet-up time, and no one's shown up. They might be in some kinda trouble!
Oof, blegh... I shoulda capped it at aroun' eight beers...
Time's a scary thing. You get focused on somethin', and before ya know it, the whole day is over.
Man, my girl's gonna go gaga over this. I always get so creative with my texts. Here goes nothin'... "Love ya!" And... send!
Where are you!? The movie's startin' soon!
Where was that motsunabe place? I'm starvin' for some good ol' fashioned organ meat!
Do I muster up my courage and go inside, or do I duck out? Decision time, come on... This maid café thing is more challengin' than it looks, and I'm not even in the door yet.
I just jumped out into the street and nearly got smashed by a car! Ahaha! You better watch out, too!
These girls and their Hakata dialect are all kinds of cute. I can't stand it!
Where'd I leave that bike o' mine? Why's this always happen to me?
My gal's takin' forever to come. It's way past the time we promised. Wait... What am I sayin'? I ain't got a girlfriend.

Man, I don't believe this shit... Got my ass whooped by a
taxi driver!
Hey, I remember you.
Oh geez! It's that muscle-bound freak again!

All right, you. Mark my words! You're gonna wish you never
made an enemy of the Devil Killers!
You hear that, asshole!? Y'fucked up real good this time!
Damn... You know that guy?
Not really. He picked a fight with me on the street a while back.
No kiddin'? That was no ordinary driving there, though. Were you ever a street racer yourself?
Heheh. Just pulling your leg. Well, sorry for all the trouble. Let me treat you to a nice meal?
You don't have to do that.
Oh, come on. You've got to let me pay you back somehow. Besides, there's something I want to ask you about.
I'll tell you while we're eating. How's that sound?
...I suppose that's fine.
Hormone diet... hormone diet... hormone diet... hormone diet...
C'mon, we don't have that kinda money!
Don't try n' deny me my dream house! Sorry, but I ain't compromisin'!
Hey, what's it take to get good at fightin' games?
It's easy. All y'gotta do is become one with the cabinet. Ya get me?
Uh... Not really.
Screw work... I don't ever wanna go back.
Wait... The stalls aren't set up for business during the daytime?
Come on, I can do this. It's not sad to karaoke solo. Go on, open the door...
Ah... The river's a lovely place. Heals my soul, it does.
He's just a taxi driver, right? They're all old guys who reek of tobacco and hair wax.
No, it's true, though. A friend told me. She said he was super-hot, and she could tell he was a beast. I could go for a ride with that.
You're wastin' your life bein' chickenshit like this. You gotta give it a try!
Yeah, but... I dunno...
My bike key's gone? What the heck? Where's my bag? Where'd I leave it!?
Oh my goodness, I hate cliffhangers. And the author's taking a break next issue! Get back to work, darn it!
Hmm... What do I feel like for lunch? After all, what you have for lunch determines how you feel for half your day.
It can get rough around here. Watch yourself.
So pissed, man. I got whupped again! Huh? Just talkin' video games, no biggie.
Now, hold on here. You're sayin' Akemi did that? Akemi!? No shit?
I doubted my eyes myself, too. I never thought I'd ever see Akemi doin' that. Sorry, man.
Nice view, eh? This is my favorite scenery in town.
Some scary goons mugged me. I can't even buy a soda now!
Hmm... Huh? I, uh, I was just lookin'! Not gonna go to some sleazy place, honest.
The first one after work's special. Talkin' ramen, of course.
I got a hankerin' for ya that burns like the summer sun!
Huh? What did you say?
Oh, hi there, Suzuki-san.
Something up, Muramatsu-san?
No... Uh, well...
I have to step out. Can you man the phone, Muramatsu-kun?
Yeah, sure. Leave it to me.
How's it goin', Muramatsu-kun?
I'm afraid things aren't looking too good.
Still actin' up, huh? You know anything 'bout computers, Suzuki-san?
Not much, no.
Hmm. That computer's been actin' up lately. Runnin' slow all of a sudden.
Huh? What's this!?
Empty windows keep popping up. They won't stop! Wait. I know what this is. It's one of those cyberterrorism attacks!
Cider terrorism? What's that?
Ya mean someone's hackin' into our computer? Whaddya think we should do, Suzuki-san!?
Cider? Hacking? Like... hacking up food?
I don't understand how this relates to computers. I'm not good with them.
Same goes for the lot of us here! But that computer's got a ton of data on it we need to hold on to!
We're countin' on ya, Suzuki-san! Can't ya think of anythin'?
Okay. I'll see what I can do. First of all...
So this box here is the computer, huh? You should try hitting it.
Ya sure that's a good idea!?
When something's acting up, I always give it a good whack first. That's how I fixed the TV back at Morning Glo⑬er, my last house.
All righty, then. I'll give it a shot!
That didn't seem to do anything.
Ya reckon this is gonna fix it? I get the feelin' this ain't how it's done.
Okay, then. Well, next up...
We should tap on the keyboard a bit. It doesn't matter what keys. Just tap away.
Ya gotta be kiddin' me! It can't be that simple, surely!
Maybe not, but doing nothing won't fix it, either. Even if it's only a small chance, we can't rule it out.
Alrighty, then. We'll give it a shot!
Guess it ain't gonna work. Nothin's changed a bit.
Well, we've eliminated that from the equation, at least. That's progress.
But our precious data's gonna get stolen at this rate! We can't let that happen!
Of course not. Next up...
I think that cord at the back of the computer might be the answer.
Cord? Oh, ya mean the LAN cable? What do I do with it!?
Pull it out. As hard as you can.
I get it! That'd take it off the network, huh? Perfect! I see now!
So did that do the trick?
What's this, Suzuki-san? Some girl is moanin' through the computer speakers!
Uh-oh. I guess it was a trap, Nakajima-san. The attacker must have known what we'd do.
They probably set it up to play that moaning sound when the cord is pulled out to stop us from getting to the bottom of this.
Whoever came up with this plan knows our every move! We're up against a tough foe.
Oh, c'mon! We can't have a girl moanin' in the office all day! 'Specially not one who keeps askin' us to "put it back in"!
Ya gotta do somethin', Suzuki-san!
Okay, next up...
Hit that box... er, computer again.
That didn't do us a lick of good before! Ain't no point in bashin' the thing to pieces, right?
I guess there isn't much point in that, no. Okay, next up...
Let's try restarting the computer. That's the thing to do in an emergency.
Aha! That's it! I shoulda thought of that myself!
Lemme see. Where's the restart...? Ah, there we go!
Hmm... That's weird. It ain't respondin' at all now.
You mean it isn't doing what you tell it? That's a problem.
Damn. Can't even shut the thing down now. Think I oughta just pull the power cable out, Suzuki-san?
The power plug? No, that would be dangerous. It could wreck the hard disk.
Can't have that! What are we s'posed to do now, then?
Hmm. I guess we could...
I'm hitting the computer.
Okay, okay! Whatever it takes. Just hurry it up!
All right, here goes.
Hiyah!
Hrah!
Gah, I can't take much more of this! That voice is gettin' me all flustered. Do somethin' quick, Suzuki-san!
Calm down, Nakajima-san. We still have other options. Next, I'll...
I'll restart the computer.
Okay, fine! I'll try anythin' at this point. Just make it fast!
Any luck?
No, it didn't seem to do anything.
Shit! We're screwed, then!
Let's plug the cord back in.
Yeah! That moanin' voice is tellin' us not to pull the LAN cable out! Good thinkin', Suzuki-san!
Aha! Did that stop the moanin'?
What's this, Suzuki-san!? It's sayin' somethin' different now! All this stuff about not pullin' out and puttin' it in deeper is gonna fry my damn circuits!
It seems they anticipated we'd do that as well.
We'll never get any work done here with this racket goin' on! I guess we're gonna have to go with the last resort!
Last resort?
Pullin' the power cord outta the computer! That'll stop it in its tracks!
But that could place a lot of strain on the hard disk. You realize you could lose all the data, right!?
Well, we ain't got much of a choice!
The data is still intact now, though. It's just a moaning voice. I think it's too early to give up yet, Nakajima-san.
We tried everythin'! That voice is drivin' me battier than a belfry at midnight!
I'm gonna do it! Let's get this over and done with! Stay outta the way, Suzuki-san!
(Maybe I should stop Nakajima-san.)
Okay, I won't stop you. Do what you think is best, Nakajima-san.
Alrighty! Here goes! I'm pullin' it out!
It stopped!
Good call, Nakajima-san. That looks like it solved the problem for now.
Oh, welcome back, Hirakawa-san.
Did something happen while I was out? Why are you all crowded around the computer?
We almost got hit by some cyberterrorists, but we have it under control now.
Under control? Ah! Did you pull the power cord out!?
We had to. The damn thing was makin' all these raunchy sounds.
Raunchy sounds? Oh, was it saying something like "Don't pull out"?
You know about computers, Hirakawa-san?
I may not look it, but I'm pretty savvy with technology. Did you have antivirus software installed on your PC, Nakajima-san?
With antivirus software installed, you wouldn't have had this mess happen in the first place.
If you pulled the power cable out...
Thought so. It's scrapped. It won't boot up anymore. The hard drive is dead as a doornail.
You'll have to get a specialist to look at it. It'll probably cost you an arm and a leg to fix, too.
I wish you'd waited until I got back. I could have fixed it in a flash.
It sounds like it was just one of those joke programs, anyway. It probably wouldn't have done any harm.
So you're sayin' if we just left it, this wouldn't have happened?
That's about the size of it, yes.
I told you it could ruin the hard disk, Nakajima-san.
It's my fault for not stopping him.
Nah, don't go blaming yourself, Suzuki-san. This is the kind of program you often find lurking on adult sites.
The people who were dumb enough to visit a site like that on a work PC are responsible.
